import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import re
from collections import Counter


def task_func(mystrings, text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        if text is None:
            raise ValueError("Input text is empty")
        try:
            items = list(text)
        except TypeError:
            raise ValueError("Input text is empty")
        if not items:
            raise ValueError("Input text is empty")
    else:
        if text.strip() == "":
            raise ValueError("Input text is empty")
        items = re.findall(r"\S+", text)

    normalized = []
    for item in items:
        token = str(item).strip()
        if token:
            normalized.append(re.sub(r"\s+", "_", token.lower()))

    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("Input text is empty")

    counts = Counter(normalized)
    unique_words = list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))
    frequencies = [counts[word] for word in unique_words]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    x = np.arange(len(unique_words))
    ax.bar(x, frequencies, color="steelblue")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(unique_words, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    fig.tight_layout()

    return ax
